subject: website
name: Web3Audio Normalizer
summary: The WEB3AUDIO Normalizer, a client-side tool that normalises track loudness in the browser. It stays at Level 2 because it loads the GoatCounter analytics script from gc.zgo.at with no integrity hash when it opens, and that script then reports the visit to web3audio.goatcounter.com. No public repository was found.

connections.name: GoatCounter analytics (gc.zgo.at, web3audio.goatcounter.com)
connections.note: Script loaded and visit reported when the page opens.
